items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: we used to get into card games and Pops used to cheat, you know

ctx.x: Oh, yes. Oh, yes. He was from New Orleans. You know, that's the reason I think that Louie always, he always -- Louie always used him when he came to New York, you see, because they were all from New Orleans. Paul Barberin was in the band. He was Danny Barberin's cousin.
